title: THE JUDGMENT OF LADY STONEHEART
narrative: Jaime Lannister is led into the hollow hill by Brienne, his golden hand clutched to his swordbelt. There sits Catelyn Stark, her throat slashed from ear to ear, crowned with bronze and weeping tears of dried blood. She holds Robb's crown in her hand and points a rotting finger at Jaime's throat. 'You swore on your honor,' the Brotherhood rumbles. But Jaime steps forward, casts down his sword, and reveals the truth of the wildfire under King's Landing: 'I slew Aerys to save half a million souls, Lady Stark — including yours.' Catelyn lowers the rope.

options.text: Ride together to the Twins to deliver justice to Walder Frey once and for all.
Ride North to Castle Black to fulfill Jaime's oath to protect the realms of men.
Ser Brynden 'Blackfish' Tully swims under the Water Gate to rally the Riverlands resistance.
Sapphires of Tarth: Jaime discovers the Isle of Tarth is a literal hollow sapphire geode.
